dct_title_s: Plans of Anchorages in Tomori Gulf and Adjacent Coast
dct_description_sm: Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
In Japanese, with title and map text also in English.
Year published "大正九年" taken from left margin, most recent correction from right margin.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, drainage, peaks.
